From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: terápia, teràpia, and terapią

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From New Latin therapīa, from Ancient Greek θεραπεία (therapeía, “service, medical treatment”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈterɑpiɑ/, [ˈt̪e̞rɑ̝ˌpiɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -iɑ
  • Syllabification(key): te‧ra‧pi‧a
  • Hyphenation(key): te‧ra‧pia

Noun

[edit]

terapia

  1. (chiefly compounds) therapy, treatment
    Synonyms: hoito, interventio (jargon)
    lääketerapia ― drug therapy
    monoterapia ― monotherapy
    puheterapia ― speech therapy
    ravitsemusterapia ― nutrition therapy
  2. therapy, counseling
    Synonyms: keskusteluhoito, psykososiaalinen interventio (jargon)
    terapian tarpeessa ― in need of therapy

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from New Latin therapīa, from Ancient Greek θεραπεία (therapeía, “service, medical treatment”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Rhymes: -ia
  • IPA(key): /te.raˈpi.a/
  • Rhymes: -ia
  • Hyphenation: te‧ra‧pì‧a

Noun

[edit]

terapia f (plural terapie)

  1. (medicine) therapy, treatment
    Synonyms: cura, trattamento
    1. (psychology) short for psicoterapia (“psychotherapy”)

    Spanish

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Borrowed from Ancient Greek θεραπεία (therapeía, “service, medical treatment”), from θεραπεύω (therapeúō, “to serve, treat medically”).

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /teˈɾapja/ [t̪eˈɾa.pja]
    • Rhymes: -apja
    • Syllabification: te‧ra‧pia

    Noun

    [edit]

    terapia f (plural terapias)

    1. (psychology) therapy
      Synonyms: tratamiento, terapéutica
    2. (medicine) treatment

    Hyponyms

    [edit]
    • terapia cognitiva conductual (“cognitive behavioral therapy”)
    • terapia ocupacional
